_comment: Full crosswalk catalog audit, dev environment, 2026-06-30. Source: hydra.Resource.resourceSearch(types:['crosswalk']) — returned 82 in one page (complete set, < pageSize 200). Each crosswalk is a published catalog resource encoding a directed sourceStandard -> targetStandard mapping (confirmed via platform.Crosswalk.get: name reflects 'source to target'). To resolve structured source/target/version for any row: platform.Crosswalk.get(id) -> { sourceStandardId, targetStandardId, latestVersionId }; element-level mappings: platform.Crosswalk.getVersion(latestVersionId).
_topology: Hub-and-spoke around SCF 2025.2.1 (target id e0000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000005a). ~75% of crosswalks are '<framework> to SCF 2025.2.1'. SCF is ALWAYS the target, never a source — it is the universal interlingua. Two non-SCF direct clusters: NIST 800-218 (SSDF) and OpenCRE, plus an AI cluster (AIUC-1 / CoSAI).

standardsReference._note: Codes + ids for the standards relevant to the 7 mock leaves and the crosswalk hubs. Resolved via platform.Standard.search.

nist_800-171_rev3.name: NIST SP 800-171 R3
nist_800-171_rev3.role: CMMC substrate (crosswalks to SCF, but NOT to CMMC)

nist_800-53_v5.name: NIST SP 800-53 R5
nist_800-53_v5.role: FedRAMP substrate (crosswalks to SCF, but NOT to FedRAMP). NOTE: 3 distinct 800-53 R5 standard records exist (nist_800-53_v5/810, nist_80053_rev5/1029, nist_80053_rev4/901) — confirm which a given crosswalk targets via Crosswalk.get.

mockLeafConnectivity._finding: Of the 7 mock leaves, only SSDF is in the crosswalk graph. CMMC, SOC2 (x2), and FedRAMP (x3) are ISLANDED — no crosswalk references them as source or target. Their NIST substrates (800-171, 800-53) crosswalk to SCF, but there is no CMMC<->800-171 or FedRAMP<->800-53 bridge crosswalk to reach them. Basis: name-scan of all 82 crosswalks (name confirmed to reflect source->target via Crosswalk.get).

ssdf.note: Richest node: 1 to-SCF + 9 direct (ASVS, CNCF SSCP, 800-160, 800-161, 800-53 R5, NIST CSF v1.1, NIST Label 2022, OWASP SAMM, OWASP SCVS) + OpenCRE->800-218.

cmmc.note: No CMMC crosswalk. Substrate NIST 800-171 R3 has a to-SCF crosswalk, but nothing bridges CMMC<->800-171.

fedramp.note: No FedRAMP crosswalk. Substrate NIST 800-53 R5 has to-SCF crosswalks, but nothing bridges FedRAMP<->800-53.
